newsitem.title: USA: Western Water stake cut by Harpel group.
newsitem.headline: Western Water stake cut by Harpel group.

text.p: A group including investor James W. Harpel and Harpel Family L.P. said Wednesday it reduced its stake in Western Water Co to 3.65 percent or 295,117 common shares of the company's 8,092,326 outstanding shares.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it sold 227,614 shares between Nov 22 and Jan 8 at $13.875 to $18.25 per share.
It holds the stake for investment.
Other names in the group listed in the filing included Harpel Partners L.P., Harpel Wheelock Partners L.P. and Harpel Select Growth L.P.
